services.name: Package
services.desc: Thank you for considering Lomond View Gardens for your special event. Our rates begin at $2,050 based on the services you need. You can either custom build your own package or book one of our pre designed packages. We have vendors for you to use but we are flexible to allow you to bring your own vendors. Catering needs to be licensed. To give you an accurate estimate, we recommend a private tour so that our wedding coordinator can customize a package that fits your needs. For your convenience, Lomond View Gardens provides an option to make partial payments up until 4 weeks prior to the event. Payments can be made in the form of cash, check, cashier’s check or credit card (3% fee for CC).
